import re,sys,yaml,json,importlib.metadata as md
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
s=open('_handoff/batch-o0/HANDOFF-P2S4-G1.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
blk=re.search(r'```yaml\n(.*?)\n```', s, re.S).group(1)
doc=yaml.safe_load(blk)
sch=json.load(open('schema/handoff.schema.json',encoding='utf-8'))
errs=sorted(Draft202012Validator(sch).iter_errors(doc), key=lambda e:list(e.path))
print('loader      : PyYAML', yaml.__version__, '/ jsonschema', md.version('jsonschema'))
print('gate        :', doc['gate'], '| slice_id:', doc['slice_id'])
print('workflow_to :', repr(doc['workflow_to']))
for e in errs: print('ERROR', '/'.join(map(str,e.path)) or '(root)', e.validator, e.message[:110])
print('errors      :', len(errs))
print('VALID against gatebraid/handoff@1' if not errs else 'INVALID')
sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)
